| Claude Opus 4.7 | `judge-opus` | 467 lines (329 valid) | 483+ lines, 增长中 | ✓ 运行中 |
| DeepSeek-V4-Pro | `judge-deepseek` | 243 lines (71 valid) | 246+ lines, 增长中 | ✓ 运行中 |
